title: Beautiful experience
text: Enrique did a marvelous job, very knowledgeable. We as tourist need to also respect instructions and the locals space. We went in a group, and there were 2 others who were delaying the tour, walking in the middle of the road, and ignoring the stated plan. Enrique tried his best to keep them engaged.
author: H111MLpaolap

title: Recommended trip!
text:
It was an incredible visit; at first I was nervous about going alone, but the guide Enrique, with his great friendliness, made me feel very comfortable.
He explained facts that are very curious and, in addition, he provided me with a place to eat after the route.
I highly recommend this route, both for the visits and explanations, and for the treatment from the tour guide.
author: 545macarenal
